name: ByteDance: Seedance 2.5
description: Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance's flagship multimodal video generation model, producing up to 30-second clips with native synchronized audio in a single pass. It accepts text, image, and reference-video/audio inputs, supports up to 30 image references, 10 video references, and 10 audio references, and offers real-person reference and timestamp-level editing/extension, aimed at cinematic storytelling and reference-driven creation.
